packs.name: Catppuccin
packs.description: Soothing pastel theme for the high-spirited. Includes Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, and Mocha flavors.

packs.description: A layered navy-black dark theme for lich, ported from the Cloud9 JetStream JetBrains theme.
